name: PANEL Self-Hosted Human Evaluation Studies
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted web platform for unlimited locally operated human evaluation studies with questionnaires, pairwise comparisons, participant consent, screening, response exports and analysis; no vendor-enforced subscription or expiration for the software.
watch_out: No hosted survey service, participant recruitment, storage, compute, or AI model usage is included. Requires your own Django-compatible server and database, secure public deployment and data protection controls; compensation and third-party model/API costs are separate.
